lockedDecisions: Vanilla TypeScript browser app built with Vite; do not introduce React, Vue, or another UI framework.
Bun is the package manager and test runner: use bun run test and bun run typecheck.
Features live under src/features/<name>/ and plug in through the existing FeatureRegistry, slots, commands, and filters contracts.
Do not edit src/features/index.ts or src/features/registry.ts; new feature folders must self-register through the existing discovery/boot contract.
Feature-specific CSS belongs inside that feature folder; src/ui/styles.css is shared and is not owned by any feature lane.
Existing localStorage persistence in src/store/persist.ts must keep its schema and migration behavior unchanged.
src/lib/dates.ts is shared date logic and only the dates-fix lane may edit it.
No new runtime packages, network access, credentials, or secrets may be added.
